trial_court: Family Court, Jhunjhunu, Civil Misc. Case No.431/2017 and another Civil Misc. Case No.429/2017
case_name: Sandeep vs Smt Sanju And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt Sanju and Dimpi (minor), wife and child

facts_of_case: Marriage of Sandeep and Suresh with respondents Sanju and Anita respectively. Matrimonial obligations performed. Appellants started mentally torturing their wives for dowry and car. Appellants left their wives and children along with 'Stridhan' at parental home.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove that he is entitled to maintenance.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is clear that the respondent wives have failed to establish any entitlement to maintenance from the appellants.

legal_principles.principle: A wife's right to maintenance is not dependent on her husband's income.
legal_principles.held: The respondent wives are trained teachers and each of them is earning Rs.15,000/- per month, but this does not affect their entitlement to pendente lite maintenance.

outcome.final_order: Appellants to pay Rs.8,000/- per month as pendente lite maintenance to the each of the wives from date of submission of application to final decision of both main petitions.
